description: Selects a source output mode and applies the requested total attenuation on every link emitted by that source.
summary: Select a source output mode and configure total attenuation on its emitted links.

resourceDeviceIds.description: Identifiers of the source and every inline attenuator that can be configured by this run.

items.description: One device identifier reserved for this configuration.

sourceDeviceId.description: Entangled-photon source whose emitted links are configured.

attenuation.description: Total attenuation requested on each emitted link. The runtime applies the largest common source contribution possible and uses inline attenuators only for link-specific residual attenuation; every bound inline attenuator declares its supported attenuation grid in network.json.

mode.description: preserve changes only output mode; networkConfigured uses the nominal HH or DD targets in network.json; maximumSource sets source attenuation to its maximum and inline attenuators to zero; maximumAvailable sets every available source and inline attenuation component to its maximum; common applies commonDb to every link; perLink applies perLinkDb to every link.

commonDb.description: Total attenuation requested on every emitted link when mode is common.

perLinkDb.description: Total attenuation requested for each source link when mode is perLink; it must contain every source link exactly once.

settleSec.description: Delay after applying the carrier configuration, in seconds.

link.configuration.applied.quantumCarrie.description: Applied output mode, requested total attenuation by link, source contribution, inline residuals, and device parameter read-backs.
